QuestInfo.name: Amnesiac Temple Keeper
QuestInfo.0: The temple keeper you helped out earlier was there. Ask the real Temple Keeper who this weirdo is.
QuestInfo.1:
Ask the Memory Keeper and about the lost Amnesiac Temple Keeper's lost memories.


Tip. The Memory Keeper's Room can be accessed through the portal on the 1st floor of Resting Spot of Memory.
QuestInfo.2: You went to #m270010111# and met with the Memory Keeper.

0.0: The #bAmnesiac Temple Keeper#k told me how you helped him out, thanks.\r\n#L0##bThe temple keeper who got lost... I guess he's new, huh?#l\n#k
0.1: Well, sort of. He keeps trying to go back and find his old memories, but I guess it's not working. He just keeps getting lost inside the temple.\r\n#L0##bHe lost his memories?#l\n#k
0.2: One day, we found him in the Gate of the Past with all his memories missing. He couldn't even remember his name! We decided to make him a temple keeper just to keep him busy...\r\nWould you be willing to help him get his memories back?

yes.0: We'll need help from the #p2140001# to figure out his name. He's the blind one who only looks at the past. If anybody knows who the Amnesiac Temple Keeper is, it'll be him.

no.0: Wow, you are a cold-hearted person, aren't you? I guess he can just wander around here without a name for all eternity.

1.0: You are quite kind to be hunting down that poor soul's memories. He's been like an empty vessel since he arrived here.

npc.0: You should still go see the #b#p2140001##k. He's in the #b#m270010111##k, which is somewhere on Memory Lane .
